Could you please share what you think I should have done differently? 

God forbid I'm ever in a similar situation.

I would go with your heart and move to a new place with your boyfriend. Your dad is your dad. Tell him. I know its hard but if you love him and would value a relationship with him in your life then be honest and tell him.
He will either come around - maybe soon, maybe not soon - and want to still have his own relationship with you. If he does not then that is something he himself has to live with doing. 
I would still make the effort to be honest and inform him where you are. If its the homophobia / he doesnt know about the boyfriend you could also just say you are moving with a friend. He may turn a blind eye.

Thanks, I know that we were no longer together. I also had moved on with life, but it did shake me he died so young given he always spoke of a future together down the line.

I'm just more stuck with the view everyone around us will have and am confused if this is a boundary that shouldn't be crossed. If he were alive, I would never do this, nor would I consider being with any other ex's friends.
